svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - general arrangement
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · CF 0.3 / WAVE-RIB CORE 10 / CF 0.3 · CORE DETAIL: SHEET 3
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE THE DRAWING. UNLESS STATED: LINEAR ±0.5, ANGULAR ±0.5°.
PROFILE SYMMETRICAL ABOUT THE CENTRE LINE. ALL ARCS TANGENT TO ADJOINING EDGES.
SANDWICH: CF FACE SHEET 0.3 + WAVE-RIB CORE 10 + CF FACE SHEET 0.3 = 10.6 ±0.2, UNIFORM OVER
BLADE AND HANDLE. BODY (SHEETS + CORE) FROM y = 5 TO THE TIP; GRIP BASE y = 0 … 5.
FACE SHEETS (2 OFF, IDENTICAL): WOVEN CARBON/EPOXY 0.3 THK (CURED), CUT TO PB-HY-001_profile.dxf
(TEMPLATE: SHEET 2), TRIMMED FLUSH WITH THE CORE EDGE.
RIB SUPPORT (CORE): CARBON FIBRE MOULDED IN ONE PIECE IN THE TWO-HALF WAVE MOULD (SHEET 4), CLOSED
FRAME 6, WAVE RIB λ23.5 / WALL 1.6 / LANDS 5.27, SOLID TO y = 150, 45° FLUTE RAMPS – SEE SHEET 3.
SKINS BONDED TO THE CORE: EPOXY, ABRADED + PRIMED FACES, PRESSED FLAT BETWEEN PLATENS OR IN A
STRENGTH: NOT QUALIFIED BY FEA. HAND CHECK (analysis/hand_check.json, README): THE 0.3 SKINS
FAIL A TIP HIT (SKIN BUCKLING BETWEEN THE LANDS, HANDLE SKIN, CORE); 0.6 SKINS PASS.
GRIP: PRINTED PLA GRIP (ANY OF THE TEN REV-8 DESIGNS; DRAWN: CARBON MATRIX, 61 g), LOCKED BY A DIN 7984
M3 × 12 SCREW INTO A BONDED M3 INSERT. REV-8 SLOT 16 > HANDLE 10.6: REGENERATE – PB-GR-002.
USA PICKLEBALL LIMITS: L + W = 580 ≤ 609.6 (24 in), L = 390 ≤ 431.8 (17 in), INCL. GRIP.
AN EDGE GUARD COUNTS TOWARDS THESE LIMITS (MARGIN 29.6).
MASS 344 g WITH THE GRIP, BALANCE POINT 193 FROM THE BUTT (FROM THE 3D MODEL).
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · 390 × 190 × 10.6 mm · CF / WAVE-RIB SANDWICH
